data.name: Durood
data.gender_notes: Durood is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A term used in Islamic tradition to seek blessings from Allah. The name Durood carries the meaning “Seeking blessings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Durood usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's mercy and kindness towards his creation
data.etymology: Durood belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeking blessings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durood total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: دُروُد
in_arabic.meaning: السلام والرحمة على النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: دُروُد تعني السلام والرحمة على النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهو تعبير عن الحب والاحترام للنبي، ويستخدم في الصلاة والسلام على النبي، وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الإيمان والتوحيد.

in_urdu.name: دُرود
in_urdu.meaning: نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم پر درود بھیجنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دُرود کا مطلب ہے نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم پر سلام و رحمت بھیجنا، یہ ایک ایسا عمل ہے جو مسلمانوں کو نبی کے ساتھ اپنے پیار اور احترام کا اظہار کرنے کی اجازت دیتا ہے، اور یہ اسلامی تقویم میں ایک اہم روایتی عمل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दुरूद
in_hindi.long_meaning: दुरूद का अर्थ है नबी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम पर सलाम और रहमत भेजना, यह एक ऐसा कार्य है जो मुसलमानों को नबी के साथ अपने प्रेम और सम्मान का प्रदर्शन करने की अनुमति देता है, और यह इस्लामी परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण कार्य है।

in_pashto.name: دُروډ
in_pashto.meaning: د حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پر دُروډ لېږل
in_pashto.long_meaning: دُروډ معنی د حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پر د سلام او رحمته لېږل دي، دا داسې عمل دی چی مسلمانانو ته اجازه ورکوي چی د نبي سره خپل مينه او احترام ښکاره کړي، او دا په اسلامي دود کي يو مهم کار دی.

in_english.name: Durood
in_english.meaning: Sending blessings and peace upon Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Durood is an expression of love and respect for Prophet Muhammad, involving the sending of blessings and peace upon him. It is a significant act in Islamic tradition, derived from Arabic roots 'darā' and 'wūd', signifying closeness and reverence. Historically, it has been an essential part of Muslim prayer and cultural heritage.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: دُروډ

data.cultural_impact: Durood is an essential part of Sufi practices and gatherings, and reciting it is considered a form of worship dedicated to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.spiritual_significance: The recitation of Durood aims to invoke Allah's mercy, forgiveness, and blessings upon the Prophet (pbuh) and seeking his intercession on our behalf. It is a means to draw closer to Allah and the Prophet (pbuh) and a way to strengthen one's bond with them. By focusing on Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the recitation of Durood, one can experience inner peace, tranquility, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Seeking blessings" symbolizes A term used in Islamic tradition to seek blessings from Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Durood serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of seeking blessings.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Durood is mentioned in the Hadith as a form of salutation The name Durood carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Durood is associated with the Islamic practice of greeting the Prophet Muhammad

trends: increasing use in Islamic literature and media
